name: Arceus
flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

legendary.requirement: Earn National Dex Diploma in Lake Valor (capture all Pokémon except Mythicals)

levelUp.name: Seismic Toss
levelUp.description: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

levelUp.name: Cosmic Power
levelUp.description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

levelUp.name: Natural Gift
levelUp.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

levelUp.name: Punishment
levelUp.description: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

levelUp.name: Gravity
levelUp.description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

levelUp.name: Earth Power
levelUp.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

levelUp.name: Hyper Voice
levelUp.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

levelUp.name: Refresh
levelUp.description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

levelUp.name: Future Sight
levelUp.description: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked with a hunk of psychic energy.

levelUp.name: Hyper Beam
levelUp.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

levelUp.name: Trick Room
levelUp.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

levelUp.name: Tailwind
levelUp.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

levelUp.name: Recover
levelUp.description: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

levelUp.name: Perish Song
levelUp.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns unless it switches out of battle.

levelUp.name: Judgment
levelUp.description: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

levelUp.name: Spacial Rend
levelUp.description: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

levelUp.name: Flamethrower
levelUp.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

tutor.name: Dive
tutor.description: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.

tutor.name: Fury Cutter
tutor.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Iron Head
tutor.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Aqua Tail
tutor.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

tutor.name: Ominous Wind
tutor.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Outrage
tutor.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

tutor.name: Signal Beam
tutor.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

tutor.name: Zen Headbutt
tutor.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Earth Power
tutor.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tutor.name: Twister
tutor.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Iron Defense
tutor.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tutor.name: Last Resort
tutor.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

tutor.name: Trick
tutor.description: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

tutor.name: Heat Wave
tutor.description: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.
